name: Certificate of Insurance
description: Proof of insurance coverage showing the policy holder, carrier, coverage limits, and effective dates.
summary: Used to verify that a vendor or subcontractor carries active insurance coverage before work starts.
structureHints: Named insured and additional insured parties
Coverage types, limits, and effective dates
Certificate holder and producer contact details
validationRules: Policy must be active on upload date
Expiration date must be after effective date
Coverage limits must meet configured minimums
Certificate holder name must match project record when configured
validationNotes: COIs are usually valid when the insurer, policy number, coverage limits, and dates are present and current.

name: Lien Waiver
description: A signed document waiving lien rights for a payment amount, often conditional or unconditional and tied to a progress or final payment.
summary: Used to confirm payment status and protect the project from mechanics lien exposure.
validationRules: Document type must match the configured waiver subtype
Conditional waivers should reference a pending or recent payment
Final waivers should indicate final payment when required
Waived amount must match or exceed the associated pay application amount
validationNotes: Lien waivers are valid when the waiver type, payment stage, amount, signatures, and exceptions all align with the payment event.

name: Invoice PDF
description: A billing document listing the seller, buyer, line items, totals, tax, payment terms, and due date.
summary: Used to match billed work or materials against a project, purchase order, or payment request.
structureHints: Line items with quantities and unit prices
Subtotal, tax, shipping, discounts, and total due
validationRules: Invoice number must be present and unique per vendor when configured
Line items must contain descriptions and amounts
Total must reconcile to line items plus tax and adjustments
Due date must not precede invoice date
validationNotes: Invoices are valid when the billing identifiers, line-item math, and payment terms are internally consistent.

name: Equipment Submittal
description: A construction submittal package that shows product data, shop drawings, cut sheets, and installation details for review.
summary: Used to confirm the proposed equipment or material matches the specification before procurement or installation.
structureHints: Dimensions, performance data, and installation notes
validationRules: Manufacturer and model must match the approved submittal record when configured
Product data must contain the required performance values
Dimensions must fit project constraints when configured
Attachments must include the referenced cut sheet or shop drawing
validationNotes: Submittals are valid when the equipment or product data aligns with the spec section and includes enough technical detail for review.

name: Request for Proposal
description: A procurement document asking vendors to propose a solution, approach, schedule, and price for a defined scope.
summary: Used to collect structured proposals from vendors when the buyer needs more than just pricing.
validationRules: Proposal should include a response to each required section
Deadline and submission instructions must be present
Vendor contact and bid form details should be identifiable
Pricing, schedule, and scope response should be present when required
validationNotes: RFPs are valid when the proposal structure is complete and the vendor response matches the requested scope and criteria.

name: Request for Quotation
description: A procurement document asking vendors to quote specific products or services with defined specifications.
summary: Used when the buyer already knows the requirements and mainly needs comparable pricing.
structureHints: Vendor pricing table or line-item quote form
validationRules: Specifications must be detailed enough for a comparable quote
Pricing must exist for each quoted line item
Quote validity period or expiration should be present when configured
Vendor response should reference the same requested quantity or unit
validationNotes: RFQs are valid when the quote clearly matches the requested items or services and includes comparable pricing.
